title: Objective slash authorization
requirements: slash authorization is separate from slash execution/distribution
slash policy is append-only and governance-published before a collateral position can freeze it
each collateral position freezes exact slash-policy revision and commitment at first stake
later slash-policy revisions cannot retroactively alter an existing position
policy freezes exact evidence-adapter address/code hash, violation predicate, bounded penalty and optional verification-policy tuple
authorization is permissionless to relay but can succeed only from final objective evidence
authorization binds exact collateral position, subject identity/account, stake policy, evidence adapter, evidence reference and unique misconduct key
authorized amount is bounded by policy bps/max cap and remaining slashable collateral after outstanding authorizations
outstanding authorization blocks matured collateral withdrawal until later slash distribution consumes it
worker objective evidence requires two conflicting canonical result digests signed by the frozen execution key for the same worker attempt and stake policy
verifier objective evidence requires final independent adjudication of the explicit verifier-objective-error ground; timeout, generic payer win or unresolved appeal are insufficient
no authorization path releases, claims, redirects or distributes Vault funds
security_boundaries: generic FAILED job state is not objective worker slash evidence
provider suspension or registry status is not slash evidence
generic adverse dispute disposition is not verifier-fault proof
governance cannot apply a newly published slash policy to a position that froze an earlier revision
evidence-adapter code hash is frozen in the slash policy
payer escrow and unrelated collateral cannot satisfy or fund a slash authorization

milestone.rationale: a shared objective slash authority now spans worker/verifier collateral sources, immutable policy snapshots, objective evidence adapters and withdrawal holds.

limitations: CMP-1.5.5 records/reserves authorization only; no authorization is consumable into Vault redistribution until CMP-1.5.6
additional worker misconduct classes require their own preaccepted objective evidence adapter; failure state alone remains fail-closed
